item.title: Wedding gowns spanning century on show
item.description: Twelve wedding dresses with Mid Canterbury connections are on display, including Helen Hanrahan’s dress, at right, from her wedding in 1969. PHOTO: DELLWYN MOYLAN From black to white, cream to pink, hand-crocheted to Lady Diana-inspired, 12 wedding dresses spanning a century are now on display at a Canterbury museum.

item.title: Site to show how power bills compare
item.description: A spike in electricity prices last year led to a government review of the market. Photo: Getty Images The electricity market regulator will launch a new power bill comparison website next month in a bid to ensure the industry better serves consumers.

item.title: Henare stepping away from politics
item.description: Peeni Henare entered Parliament in 2014. Photo: RNZ By Lillian Hanly of RNZ Senior Labour MP Peeni Henare is "taking a step back from politics", saying the time has come to put his energy elsewhere.

item.title: Full test scrapped in driver licensing changes
item.description: Transport Minister Chris Bishop. Photo: RNZ / Nathan McKinnon A shake-up for the driver licensing system is on its way, with changes the government says will make it a lot cheaper for those looking to get their licence.

item.title: Submerged catamaran close to Akaroa shore
item.description: The boat ran aground in the Akaroa Marine Reserve last Saturday, resulting in the rescue of more than 40 passengers and crew. Image: supplied By Adam Burns of RNZ New drone footage shows the stranded Black Cat Cruises catamaran submerged close to shore in a small rocky bay in Akaroa Harbour on Canterbury's Banks Peninsula.

item.title: Pharmac urged to fund weight loss drug for teens
item.description: Wegovy is a weight loss drug that is injected weekly. Photo: JENS KALAENE A paediatric specialist is urging New Zealand's drug funding agency to fund weight loss medication for teenagers.
